::: {.hero}
Since 2009, Andrew Gelman has kept a running [Handy Statistical Lexicon](https://statmodeling.stat.columbia.edu/2009/05/24/handy_statistic/) on his blog: short, funny names for "important methods and concepts related to statistics that are not as well known as they should be." This site gives each of the **153 entries** its own page, with an explanation and an interactive simulation that runs in your browser.

I love this page and have learned a lot from reading it through the years. With the help of coding agents, I built this homage to the author and the lexicon itself, enjoy it.

[Start here](start-here.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .me-2} [Random entry](random.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .me-2} [About this site](about.qmd){.btn .btn-link}
:::
